UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile linked to Firebase Auth UID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the terminal profile menu.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Auth.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update.

PortfolioPosition.title: PortfolioPosition
PortfolioPosition.description: Tracked financial asset holding belonging to a specific user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the position owner.

symbol.description: Ticker or Yahoo asset symbol (e.g. ^GSPC, BTC-USD, GC=F, BBCA.JK).

avgCost.description: Average purchase cost per unit in USD.

currentPrice.description: Latest recorded price per unit in USD.

linkedAssetId.description: Optional market feed symbol ID for live price syncing.

portfolioId.description: Optional portfolio list identifier for multi-list sync across devices.

portfolioName.description: Optional portfolio display name for cross-device list restoration.

nativeCurrency.description: Native quote currency of the holding (USD or IDR).

nativeAvgCost.description: Average purchase cost in the holding's native currency to prevent FX drift.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Terminal preferences such as NFP alert status and currency conversion defaults.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

nfpAlertEnabled.description: Whether the NFP countdown macro catalyst alert is enabled.

preferredCurrency.description: Default currency code for FX Matrix.

favoriteAssetIds.description: Bounded list of pinned watchlist asset IDs (max 30).

AiBrief.title: AiBrief
AiBrief.description: Saved Google Search grounded market intelligence brief generated by Gemini.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the brief owner.

sources.description: Bounded list of cited source titles/URIs (max 10).

SignalHistoryRecord.title: SignalHistoryRecord
SignalHistoryRecord.description: Immutable-entry trading signal log with continuous lifecycle tracking (PENDING_LIMIT, RUNNING, TP1_HIT, TP2_HIT, SL_HIT, BE_CLOSED, EXPIRED) across stocks, crypto, and commodities.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signal owner.

lockKey.description: Continuity deduplication key (e.g. idx_scanner:BBCA.JK or ict_radar:BTCUSD:15m).

firstShownPrice.description: Spot price when signal was first detected and locked.

status.description: Canonical signal lifecycle status (PENDING, FILLED, EXPIRED, TP, SL) validated server-side against real-time ticks.

filledOnFirstSight.description: True if price was already inside entry/running when signal first appeared.

executionPosture.description: Captured radar execution posture at signal lock.

zoneFillVerified.description: True once live spot or candle wick verified entry inside Entry Zone.

verificationStatus.description: Real-time entry-zone verification status updated upon price crossing the entry zone or expiring unfilled.

verifiedAtMs.description: Epoch ms when real-time zone verification transitioned to Verified or Expired.

journaledAtMs.description: Epoch ms when trader annotated the trade journal outcome or note.

timestamp.description: Indexed signal creation epoch milliseconds (mirrors createdAtMs) for composite timeline queries.

strategy.description: Indexed canonical strategy identifier for performance hit-rate queries.

outcome.description: Indexed unified signal outcome (derived from manual journal outcome or live TP/SL status) for hit-rate analytics.

createdAtMs.description: Client epoch milliseconds when signal first locked.

filledAtMs.description: Optional epoch ms when entry filled.

tp1HitAtMs.description: Optional epoch ms when TP1 was reached.

closedAtMs.description: Optional epoch ms when terminal outcome occurred.

closedPrice.description: Optional execution price at terminal close.

lastPrice.description: Most recently checked live market price.

maxFavorablePrice.description: Best favorable price reached since fill.

maxAdversePrice.description: Worst adverse price reached since fill.

pnlPct.description: Live unrealized or realized percentage return.

rMultiple.description: Live or realized R-multiple relative to initial risk.

lastCheckedAtMs.description: Epoch ms of latest continuity evaluation.

mfeR.description: Maximum Favorable Excursion in R-multiples since entry fill.

maeR.description: Maximum Adverse Excursion in R-multiples since entry fill.

barrierOutcome.description: Triple-Barrier classification (Upper TP, Lower SL, Vertical Time Barrier, Break Even, or Open).

timeBarrierAtMs.description: Vertical time-barrier deadline epoch ms for Triple-Barrier expiration.

inKillzone.description: Whether the setup triggered inside an active London/NY institutional Killzone.

po3Aligned.description: Whether entry aligned with Power of 3 / NY Midnight Open AMD side.

smtConfirmed.description: Whether structural SMT divergence confirmed the setup.

volatilityRegime.description: Dual-TF volatility regime at signal lock.

htfAligned.description: Whether the setup aligned with the 1H/4H higher-timeframe bias.

netRr.description: Net-of-friction reward-to-risk ratio at signal lock.

stage2Aligned.description: Whether the equity passed the Minervini / Weinstein Stage 2 uptrend template at lock.

rsRank.description: Cross-sectional Relative Strength percentile rank (1..99) vs benchmark at lock.

vcpDetected.description: Whether a Volatility Contraction Pattern with volume dry-up was active at lock.

sectorLeader.description: Whether the stock belonged to a Top-3 leading sector in its market at lock.

orderType.description: Recommended order type at signal lock (e.g. BUY NOW, SELL LIMIT, BUY STOP).

expiredReason.description: Explicit reason why an EXPIRED signal ended (invalidation vs unfilled).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when signal was persisted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest lifecycle update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/positions/{positionId}.description: User-owned portfolio positions synced across web, Android, and iOS browsers.

/users/{userId}/aiBriefs/{briefId}.description: User-saved Gemini + Google Search grounded market briefs.

/users/{userId}/signalHistory/{signalId}.description: Persistent user signal continuity ledger tracking locked entry, TP1, TP2, SL, and running status.
